classification.difficultyReason: Convert the given length to centimetres before forming and solving the perimeter equation.

content.prompt: A rectangle has a perimeter of 126 cm. Calculate the breadth if the length is 0.3 m.

spec.answerVisibility: Only stated dimensions or unknowns; no derived answers.

answer.worked:
$0.3\text{ m}=30\text{ cm}$.

Let $b$ be the breadth in centimetres.

$$\begin{align*}P&=2l+2b\\126&=2(30)+2b\\126&=60+2b\\66&=2b\\b&=33\end{align*}$$

The breadth is $33\text{ cm}$.
